participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Adventurous and resilient, always looking for ways to challenge themselves. Has a competitive spirit and enjoys pushing limits.
participant_1.background: I wear a motorbike helmet to protect my head. I've light skin with big brown eyes. It's red with a blue stripe, so it shines when I race. My main transportation is my motorbike.

participant_2.name: Emily
participant_2.personality: Optimistic and nurturing, with a strong sense of empathy. Passionate about health and fitness, always encouraging others to do their best.
participant_2.background: I am a cancer survivor. I got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. I'm a clean eater. I love running and preparing for marathons.
